note: Simple averages of NSE closes over the sessions each name traded. A one-session fall beyond 25% is scaled out of the earlier closes only on evidence of a split, bonus or demerger (scan share count, screener's rescaled 200-DMA, or an open beyond the price band); otherwise, a crash, the closes stay raw. Each such date is listed in the row's "ca" as [date, factor or null, how]. Built by tools/build_averages.py.
